hypotheses.name: H0 persistent topology of gene embedding filtration
hypotheses.method: Betti-0 persistence barcode via union-find on cosine-distance MST edges, across all 12 layers. Null: per-dimension feature-shuffle preserving marginal distributions. Metrics: total persistence ratio (real/null), max component lifetime, n long-lived components (lifetime > 0.10 cosine dist).
hypotheses.result_value: L0=0.921 → L11=0.251 (monotonically decreasing); n_long_ratio L11=0.39 (real 590 vs null 1499 long-lived components)
hypotheses.next_action: Investigate which specific gene clusters collapse (biological annotation of persistent vs ephemeral components). Also test H1 (1-cycle) persistence if ripser becomes available.
hypotheses.interpretation: Real gene embeddings have consistently LOWER total H0 persistence than feature-shuffle null at all layers. Ratio drops from 0.92 (L0) to 0.25 (L11). This means late-layer real embeddings are far MORE COMPACT (fewer separated clusters) than random — genes converge into tighter clusters rather than spreading out. n_long decreases from 1499 at L0 to 590 at L11 (null stays at 1499), indicating the real embedding geometry at L11 has far fewer distinct topological features. This is a topological confirmation of rank compression: not just fewer singular-vector dimensions, but actual topological clustering of genes.
hypotheses.prior_phase_comparison: phase9a stub reported only 1 connected component at a single threshold — not a true filtration. This analysis is entirely new.

hypotheses.name: Per-gene local intrinsic dimensionality stratified by TF/target annotation
hypotheses.method: Levina-Bickel MLE with k=20 cosine-kNN per gene per layer. Gene stratification: TF_only (n=151), TF_and_target (n=192), target_only (n=595), string_member (n=553), other (n=9). Mann-Whitney tests with BH-FDR correction.
hypotheses.result_value: Mean global LID: 46.7 (L0) → 3.52 (L11), 13.3x compression. TF_only lower LID than target_only at L6 (q=0.015, delta=-0.77), L3 (q=0.116), L11 (q=0.055). string_member has lowest LID at most layers.
hypotheses.next_action: Visualize LID trajectories per group. Test whether genes with highest L0→L11 LID drop are enriched for specific pathways (GO BP / Reactome).
hypotheses.interpretation: TF genes consistently occupy lower-LID (more concentrated) neighborhoods than target genes across layers. The difference is statistically significant at L6 (q=0.015) and borderline at several other layers. STRING members have the lowest LID of all groups. Global LID compression (47→3.5, 13.3x) is stronger than previously measured TwoNN compression (6.1x), suggesting LID captures local structure the global TwoNN misses. The TF<target LID ordering is consistent with TFs being co-located regulatory hubs while targets are more dispersed.

hypotheses.name: STRING PPI cohesion in gene kNN graph across layers
hypotheses.method: kNN graph (k=15, cosine similarity) per layer. STRING precision@k: fraction of STRING 700/900 pairs that are direct kNN neighbors. Null: hypergeometric expectation (random edge assignment). Also: normalized Laplacian Fiedler value across layers.
hypotheses.result_value: L0: z_700=23.0, z_900=21.2 (HIGHLY significant). Drops to z≈1-3 by L4-L6. Mild recovery: L8 z_700=3.8, z_900=4.2; L11 z_700=3.0. Fiedler value: 0.166 (L0) → 0.008 (L11), 21x decrease.
hypotheses.next_action: Characterize which STRING gene pairs persist as kNN neighbors through all layers (most structurally invariant pairs). Compare to which pairs appear only at L0 (token-embedding-encoded) vs only at late layers (contextually reconstructed).
hypotheses.interpretation: KEY FINDING: MaxToki L0 (token embeddings) STRONGLY encodes STRING PPI topology as kNN proximity (z=23.0 for STRING-700 pairs). This drops rapidly after the first transformer block (L1: z=10.8, L4: z=3.2) and partially recovers at L8 (z=3.8) and L11 (z=3.0). This differs from the SV3 analysis which found PPI signal at 3/12 layers: the kNN approach captures LOCAL co-localization and reveals strong L0 signal that the SVD-based global analysis missed (SVD axes are dominated by variance structure, not local pairwise proximity). The Fiedler decay (0.166→0.008) indicates the kNN graph becomes increasingly fragmented at late layers — consistent with gene clusters becoming very tight (within-cluster edges) while between-cluster connectivity drops to near zero.
